audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers read Akshan for all seven stages while the whys describe Mordekaiser owning Levels 2-3 and 6 and a stalemate at 4-5 and first item; the packet levelChart reads Akshan / Mordekaiser / Mordekaiser / Skill / Mordekaiser / Skill / Akshan.
audit.why: A flat seven-row Akshan chart told the reader he loses every stage of a lane the same page says he wins at 6.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet read in matched full+content pairs, ratings rescaled, and whys[0]/[1] plus phases[3]/[5]/[6] why-text retimed so the prose lands on the right rows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Heroic Swing was the tracked cooldown on eight surfaces and its duration appeared nowhere.
audit.why: Every engage instruction hangs on that timer.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing written as 18s at rank 1 in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[2].d and report[5].t; Obliterate as 8s at rank 1; Avengerang range 850.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Heroic Swing needs terrain to grapple, and Comeuppance stops on the first champion, minion or structure it hits.
audit.why: Riot’s E text says he fires a hook into terrain; the R text says the bullets damage the first champion, minion, or structure hit.
audit.corrected: report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns tell you to fight him away from walls; whys[6] tells you to keep a minion between you and his 2500-range R.

edits.before: Q ranks make isolated hits massive. Akshan must hug minions all lane; punish every step away from the wave with the full drag combo.
edits.after: Q ranks make isolated hits massive, but Avengerang out-ranges them at 850 and Heroic Swing leaves. Neither of you can force a kill here.

edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage.
edits.after: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — 18s at rank 1, and it must hook terrain. Step up the moment it is spent.

edits.before: Akshan wastes Heroic Swing — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Heroic Swing is 18s at rank 1 — pull him the moment it is spent.

edits.before: That is Akshan's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: He kites with Avengerang at 850 range; chasing without Darkness Rise is free poke.

edits.before: Burning your answer for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Your Q is 8s at rank 1; spending it on the wave leaves the pull naked.

edits.before: Track Akshan's Heroic Swing: His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. When it is down — E-pull + Q, then R the 1v1.
edits.after: Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1 and it must hook terrain, so fight him away from walls. When it is spent — E-pull, Q, then R.

edits.before: He out-ranges you at 1-2: Avengerang double-pokes on the return and his passive shields him off autos, so he trades for free while you have one Q and no aura — concede CS, don't contest.
edits.after: He out-ranges you at 1: Avengerang double-pokes on the return and his passive shields him off autos, so he trades for free while you have one Q and no aura — concede CS, don't contest.

edits.before: Your kit comes online at 3-4: W banks his poke and the E-pull into Obliterate into a 3-hit Darkness Rise proc out-trades a sustain-less skirmisher if you pin him.
edits.after: W online at 2 banks his poke as shield-health you can eat back, so short Q-auto trades come back even against a skirmisher with no sustain of his own.

edits.before: Full-build Akshan kites your slow Q with Heroic Swing off any terrain and snowballs off roams — your flat mid-game can't catch a skirmisher who never stands still.
edits.after: Full-build Akshan kites your slow Q with Heroic Swing off any terrain and snipes with Comeuppance — its bullets stop on the first minion, so never stand clear of your wave.

edits.before: Liandry's makes Darkness Rise melt through bruiser HP stacking. Extended trades are now strictly yours — force them.
edits.after: Liandry's melts HP, but his lethality Q pokes from outside your 675 range. You need the E connect; he needs only to walk.

edits.before: Riftmaker omnivamp turns the Realm 1v1 unloseable into most matchups. Akshan's only outs are dodging Q forever or never being alone — neither survives a whole game.
edits.after: Riftmaker keeps the Realm 1v1 strong, but Heroic Swing off any wall means you never pin him for long, and he snowballs the map off camouflage roams.

notes: 35 games — the 49.01% win rate is thin, so no difficulty or carry rating was moved on it. Mordekaiser Q carries a derived grounding flag Riot’s description does not support, so nothing claims Q denies Heroic Swing. suspectNames flagged "Use Heroic Swing" — false positive, Heroic Swing is correct. Akshan’s W camouflage and Scoundrel resurrect are in the page text and check out against the kit.
